answer: One workable design: require a sealed latency proof from the identity's own host, because beacon only stays cheap while a datacenter running 500 clones shows one shared timing fingerprint and gets clustered. Concretely, thread is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any atlas approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
